mapper.sql: o.id,o.course_id,c.course_code,c.name course_name,c.course_type,c.credit,c.weekly_periods, o.teacher_id,t.teacher_no,t.name teacher_name,o.class_id,ac.class_name, o.semester_id,sem.name semester_name,o.capacity, (select count(*) from student_course sc where sc.offering_id=o.id) student_count
from course_offering o join course c on c.id=o.course_id join teacher t on t.id=o.teacher_id join administrative_class ac on ac.id=o.class_id join semester sem on sem.id=o.semester_id
mapper.select: select cs.id,cs.weekday,cs.start_period,cs.end_period,cs.classroom_id, cr.building,cr.room_no,sp.start_time,ep.end_time from course_schedule cs join classroom cr on cr.id=cs.classroom_id join class_period sp on sp.period_no=cs.start_period join class_period ep on ep.period_no=cs.end_period where cs.offering_id=#{offeringId} order by cs.weekday,cs.start_period
select count(*) from course_schedule cs join course_offering o on o.id=cs.offering_id where and cs.classroom_id=#{classroomId}
select count(*) from course_schedule cs join course_offering o on o.id=cs.offering_id where and o.teacher_id=#{teacherId}
select count(*) from course_schedule cs join course_offering o on o.id=cs.offering_id where and o.class_id=#{classId}
select count(*) from student_course where offering_id=#{offeringId}
select count(*) from student_course where student_id=#{studentId} and offering_id=#{offeringId}

select s.id, s.stu_id as studentNo, s.name, s.gender, ac.class_name as className, s.image as image from student_course sc join student s on s.id=sc.student_id join administrative_class ac on ac.id=s.class_id where sc.offering_id=#{offeringId} order by s.stu_id
